headings: Placing Customer Adds Product to Cart
text: **Simple Add to Cart** Once a product is selected Customer adds it to the list to be ordered (which may be a shopping cart to order now, or shopping list to order later), specifying the quantity of the product desired.
limitation: No verified browser workflow in the installed Marble components; storefront, integration, manual action or mapping required.
